title: Agree the mandate, sponsor and goals
summary: Building product capability changes how people work, so it needs a clear mandate and a senior sponsor. Agree what success looks like before you start.

beginner: Write down why the organisation wants to improve product practice.
Name a senior sponsor who will back the work.
Agree two or three goals, such as faster decisions or better outcomes.
Agree the scope: which teams and roles.
Share the mandate on one page.
intermediate: Link the goals to business outcomes, not just training numbers.
Agree how much time people can give to the change.
Agree how progress will be reported.
experienced: Align the mandate with company strategy and leadership priorities.
Secure budget and people for the work.
Set expectations that change takes time.

canDelegateTo.task: Advise on people and HR implications

toolExamples.confluence: Publish the mandate as the first page of the programme.
toolExamples.notion: Keep the mandate and goals in one place.

pitfalls: Scope that is too big to start
